description: This file defines the interface for a disk cache used by libwebsockets, including functions for creating, destroying, preparing, querying, finalizing names, trimming cache size, and calculating idle time before next trim. It includes data structures, function prototypes, and documentation for managing a disk-based cache with an LRU mechanism.

methods.name: lws_diskcache_create
methods.description: Creates an opaque struct representing the disk cache, initialized with cache directory path and size limit.

methods.name: lws_diskcache_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the disk cache object and frees associated resources.

methods.name: lws_diskcache_prepare
methods.description: Prepares directory structure on disk for the cache, ensuring correct permissions and ownership.

methods.name: lws_diskcache_query
methods.description: Checks if a cache file exists or needs to be created, returning relevant info and file descriptor.

methods.name: lws_diskcache_finalize_name
methods.description: Renames a temporary cache file to its final name after content generation.

methods.name: lws_diskcache_trim
methods.description: Performs cache size management by deleting oldest files if cache exceeds size limit.

methods.name: lws_diskcache_secs_to_idle
methods.description: Indicates how long to wait before calling trim again based on cache size status.
